ChaCha-based RNG APIs, state management, refill functions, and uniform ulong sampling.

# Purpose
This header defines the public interface for a ChaCha-based random number generator used by the Solana protocol. It declares the `fd_chacha_rng_t` state object, memory management functions such as [`fd_chacha_rng_new`](<#fd_chacha_rng_new>), [`fd_chacha_rng_join`](<#fd_chacha_rng_join>), [`fd_chacha_rng_leave`](<#fd_chacha_rng_leave>), and [`fd_chacha_rng_delete`](<#fd_chacha_rng_delete>), and seed initialization functions for [`fd_chacha8_rng_init`](<#fd_chacha8_rng_init>) and [`fd_chacha20_rng_init`](<#fd_chacha20_rng_init>). The file also provides inline helpers to read 64-bit values from the buffered stream and to generate an unbiased value in `[0, n)` with [`fd_chacha20_rng_ulong_roll`](<#fd_chacha20_rng_ulong_roll>). It selects refill implementations for AVX512, AVX, or sequential code, and it includes configuration macros for buffer size, debug logging, and roll mode selection.
